claim: Patchline ships an adversarial-collaboration study with a skeptic co-author and an agreed analysis plan. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the adversarial-collaboration claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make adversarial-collaboration-gate`.
